searchText: b"h boruch hashem blessed is he continuation revelation — the river must be proven, not merely painted the awtsmoos renews every instant; awtsmoos.com must renew every claim through evidence. this continuation does not restart the prior overhaul. it inherits its real artifacts, challenges unverified edges, and closes the remaining graph by runtime proof. observed inheritance the prior three phase plan exists and has been read in full. auto scroll now imports the production storage key instead of hard coding an old version. the semantic default is 45 wpm, contemplate, about 15 px/s. a root resolver exists for document scroll and genuinely scrollable .scroll view wrapper vessels. reader settings, floating actions, discussion, and social core styles were already modularized. historical heichel archaeology proves route context includes can fail silently, so browser/runtime proof is mandatory. remaining work 1. run targeted auto scroll tests unchanged first. 2. discover parent package scripts and actual server command. 3. derive the recursive active post css closure and conflict map. 4. trace community /comment tree client to server behavior. 5. trace and verify main menu ownership plus every registered child view. 6. verify all scribe's lens controls, focus, internal scroll, safe areas, and reduced motion. 7. sweep heichel source/runtime across mobile, tablet, desktop, rtl/ltr, and state variants. 8. inventory and sweep all user facing heichelos routes. 9. inspect the full social import graph and visible subsystems beyond core feed css. 10. audit post/heichel/social/shared css for active conflicts and classify dormant debt. 11. rewrite whole files only where evidence proves a defect; split modules where needed. 12. run discovered tests, js syntax checks, and regression scans. 13. verify 390x844, 430x932, 768x1024, and 1440x900 browser classes. 14. review console and network failures on important routes. 15. re read every modified file, audit line counts, and compare plan versus actual. 16. write implementation readback, browser proof, and final completion gate notes into the original 0240 directory. next action run the inherited auto scroll unit contracts exactly as the working tree defines them. a pass closes only the unit test node; browser measured behavior remains open.

excerpt: B"H Boruch Hashem Blessed is He Continuation Critique — Gevurah Against Apparent Completion The Awtsmoos gives form to light; Awtsmoos.com must give each selector and behavior a bounded vessel. This pass attacks inherited success so cosmetic completion cannot masquerade as product completion. Thirty improvements and tr
searchText: b"h boruch hashem blessed is he continuation critique — gevurah against apparent completion the awtsmoos gives form to light; awtsmoos.com must give each selector and behavior a bounded vessel. this pass attacks inherited success so cosmetic completion cannot masquerade as product completion. thirty improvements and traps to test 1. passing auto scroll unit tests is insufficient until a real owning element moves. 2. prove pause by a stable scrolltop interval, not merely a status string. 3. prove resume by renewed measured movement. 4. prove stop by state and stable movement after enough frames could occur. 5. change wpm during a run and compare measured velocity. 6. confirm inner root selection only when computed overflow and extent prove it scrollable. 7. confirm natural document fallback on a real route. 8. build css closure from html links plus recursive @import, never a directory grep alone. 9. distinguish active historical css from dormant history before deletion. 10. count every active !important; the rewritten active system must not depend on it. 11. find competing fixed position ownership for rails, settings, menu, comments, and sidebars. 12. map z index layers semantically instead of escalating arbitrary numbers. 13. test hover only on hover capable input and active feedback on touch. 14. test :focus visible through keyboard navigation, not source inspection alone. 15. emulate reduced motion and verify ambient movement actually stops or collapses. 16. verify safe area handling at both 390x844 and 430x932. 17. open every registered main menu child and verify return navigation. 18. ensure dismissal removes invisible interceptors and restores underlying reader access. 19. ensure scribe's lens internal scroll does not drag the underlying reader. 20. verify every scribe control changes real state and reset returns production defaults. 21. trace community errors to the actual server response; never fake an empty state. 22. verify retry creates a fresh request and can recover after failure. 23. verify paragraph indexing, especially displayed para 27 versus transport indexing. 24. verify heichel, series, post, and alias ids are correct and url safe. 25. test long english and hebrew heichel titles for wrap, direction, and displaced actions. 26. test heichel empty/loading/error states, not only happy state cards. 27. ensure every social style, including pseudo elements and media rules, remains beneath .awtsmoos social root. 28. inspect profile, composer, notifications, reactions, comments, discovery, search, side rails, and admin looking surfaces beyond the feed. 29. review every touched file over 120 lines for safe extraction without shrinking documentation. 30. search for regressions after each repair because one resolved ownership conflict can reveal another. evidence order browser observation measured dom state network/server response integration test unit test static inspection inference. delta questions which prior acceptance criteria were never browser tested? which active imports still carry historical ownership? which user facing routes were absent from the original plan? which runtime failures predate this pass but are exposed by the redesign? which old compatibility layers are still necessary, and which are merely imported debt? next action after auto scroll unit tests, derive the active post css closure and route/runtime graph while tracing community transport, then choose only the smallest whole file rewrites supported by evidence.

searchText: b"h boruch hashem blessed is he continuation final plan — one owner, one river, one verified product the awtsmoos recreates every moment from nothing; awtsmoos.com must recreate certainty from direct proof. the continuation path is evidence led: test inherited behavior, discover active ownership, rewrite only proven defects, then verify the full user journey. phase a — inherited behavior run autoscrollroot.test.mjs and autoscrolldown.test.mjs unchanged first. read semantic pace, preferences, root resolver, document adapter, and movement controller as one execution graph. if a test fails, prove whether production or test is stale before rewriting a whole file. phase b — active ownership map read awtsmoos.post.html, main.css, direct loaded reader styles, and recursive descendants. map active conflicts for floating controls, auto scroll, typography settings, scroll root, sidebar, overlays, community, menus, sheets, and z index. read heichel template/bootstrap/style closure and social index.css/bootstrap closure. inventory user facing route entrypoints under heichelos. phase c — runtime behavior trace community: panel fetching tree /comment tree server route data/auth response. main menu: trigger registry overlay/sheet child views back navigation. scribe's lens: trigger settings state controls persistence/reset. heichel: template bootstrap cards/series/posts/actions/menu/dialogs/social surfaces. social: root navigation/feed/profile/composer/notifications/interactions/search/discovery/comments. phase d — whole file repairs only for every proven defect: read the full current owner; preserve working public selectors/exports/contracts; rewrite the whole file; split oversized responsibility into focused modules; use tabs, b"h / boruch hashem / blessed is he headers, and meaningful awtsmoos oriented documentation; introduce neither !important nor selector escalation. phase e — browser proof start the real server from discovered package scripts. verify 390x844, 430x932, 768x1024, and 1440x900. measure auto scroll start, pause, resume, stop, and pace change on the owning root. verify main menu and all registered child views. verify scribe's lens controls, internal scroll, focus, safe area, and reduced motion. verify community success, truthful failure, retry recovery, and empty state distinction. sweep heichel and social routes with console/network evidence. phase f — completion audit run discovered tests and syntax checks. re scan active css closure for !important and duplicate ownership. wc l every touched source file. re read every touched file in full. compare the original 0240 plan to actual implementation and this continuation delta. write 03 implementation readback.md, 04 browser verification.md, and 05 final delta and completion gate.md into the original 0240 folder without overwriting history. completion gate no success claim until all sixteen user stated gates have evidence. a genuine external blocker must identify the exact failed capability and preserve all completed surrounding proof; otherwise remaining work must become empty. next action execute phase a, then immediately continue into phase b even if every auto scroll unit test is green.
